headline: S H Kelkar and Company receives cautionary letters from BSE and NSE
hook: Exchanges issue warnings to fragrance maker
summary: S H Kelkar and Company Limited announced that it received cautionary letters via email from both BSE and National Stock Exchange on October 27, 2026. The company did not disclose the specific reasons or violations that triggered the exchange intervention in its regulatory filing. Retail shareholders of the fragrance and aroma ingredient maker should track subsequent disclosures for compliance impact.
whats_next: Company clarification or further exchange notices
why_it_matters: Regulatory caution letters could signal compliance hurdles for the company.
